svg.title: yak Nesting
svg.desc: A Button nests a media query and a prop branch. At build time, yak keeps the nesting in the CSS file, and the prop branch becomes its own class with its own media query. In the browser, the classes stay the same and only the window width switches the font size.

g.text: Write CSS nesting like in a stylesheet.
yak keeps the nesting in the CSS file
The prop branch becomes a class with its own @media block.
The browser applies the media query
The classes stay the same. Only the window width changes.
